title: A bound method refuses a kit the lock does not install
summary: A method bound by a repository now runs only a kit the repository's own lock installs. A bound kit that no lock row names (a packages row, or a kit row of a package carrier in entries) refuses with IA-CORE-KIT-NOT-INSTALLED before anything is retained, restored, written or run, and no bundled, IA-home or retained copy stands in for it; a task pin older than the installed version keeps running. The runtime exports kitInstallation, requireKitInstalled and kitInstallMatches for the lock's row and its identity.
